elements.title: Five-number summary for salaries at a company
elements.details:
| Statistic             | Salary (USD) |
|-----------------------|--------------|

elements.summary: This table shows the five-number summary statistics for a dataset of employee salaries at a company, including minimum, first quartile, median, third quartile, and maximum salaries.
